value.rationale: The source introduces approximate (K,K*)-duality as a reconstruction mechanism and immediately uses Lemma 19 to convert it into a K-frame conclusion. The published hypothesis can instead produce a singular normalized reconstruction and a sequence with no K-frame lower bound. The repair is structural and reusable: it identifies the condition number factor required when approximate identity reconstruction is transported to reconstruction near a non-isometric operator K.
